item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, there will be fog over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be rather warm during the day on Monday and Tuesday. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Wednesday morning. It will become appreciably cooler over the region. Showers will affect the region in the middle and the latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 20/03 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. Mist patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
